design_read: Operate (macOS native daily utility) x multi-stream media acquisition tool x Precision Instrument (optical studio hardware) x single anchor: live throughput progress track & tabular telemetry in the download queue.

typography.heading_stack: SF Pro Display, PingFang SC, system-ui
typography.body_stack: SF Pro Text, PingFang SC, system-ui

motion_budget.reduce_motion_fallback: opacity 150ms easeOut, no translation or pulse

guardrails: Strict <= 6 distinct colors per frame/screen (5 normal + 1 danger only on faults).
No purple/indigo (OKLCH 270-330), no warm-cream+terracotta cliché, no pure #000/#FFF ink.
No ghost cards (never combine 1px border with >=16px blur shadow); use surface contrast + 1px ink hairlines.
Status triple-coded by icon + label + tone so grayscale screenshot stays 100% legible.
All dynamic numbers (speed, bytes, percent, ETA, counts) enforce monospacedDigit().
